package.description: Free Screen Capture and Image Editing Utility.

en-US.description: Free Screen Capture and Image Editing Utility.
en-US.longDescription:
SnipSVG is a screen capture and graphics editor that uses SVG vector images as its primary format.
SVG images can be used directly in HTML and many other applications. They give you the same sharp quality at all zoom settings, and unlike JPG or PNG images you can always edit all the elements of the image separately.
en-US.name: SnipSVG by EC Software

zh-CN.description: 免费屏幕截图与图像编辑工具。
zh-CN.longDescription:
SnipSVG 是一款以 SVG 矢量图为主要格式的屏幕截图与图形编辑器。
SVG 图像可直接用于 HTML 及众多其他应用程序。无论缩放级别如何变化，它们都能保持同样清晰的画质，且与 JPG 或 PNG 图像不同，您始终可以单独编辑图像中的所有元素。
